retentionChecks.name: deletes abandoned and terminal evidence but preserves active settlement and current paid reports
starts a stable 30-day clock at first release and does not extend it on retry
does not disclose an expired report to another user and rejects downloaded expired data
keeps deletion pending after partial failure and retries without reviving the report
coordinates cleanup with writes and removes only old unreferenced objects
rejects storage aliases before deleting an object
PRI-06 restores a real database, encrypted objects, and keys, then removes expired data before access

acceptance.evidence: Actual pg_dump and pg_restore; expired object rejection and repeated deletion; current paid report decryption and receipt preservation.

acceptance.reason: Hosted backup custody, backup expiry, and live-chain reconciliation remain unverified.
